relation: one contract, a chordless vertex-sequence cycle: a MathComp ucycle of host adjacency in which every host edge between two of its vertices joins cyclically consecutive entries (cyclic_chordless, over seq_cyclic_consecutiveb, no distinctness premise); three views differ only in the length bound. GTBase.induced_cycles.chordless_ucycle (no bound: the empty list and the two-vertex cycle of an edge qualify) is Extremal.D2str.induced_cycle by conversion (cyc_edge is seq_cyclic_consecutiveb); chordless_cycle (2 < size c, the same term as 3 <= size c) is GTMisc.X91.x91_induced_cycle (redundant u != v after the edge, Prop consecutiveness) and Packing.XE1.xe1_induced_cycle (redundant x != y before the edge, inline Boolean pair test) by explicit iffs; hole (3 < size c) is Chromatic.X3.x3_hole (three-way conjunction, u != v before the edge, Prop consecutiveness) and Minor.X27.x27_hole (x != y after the edge) by explicit iffs. The distinctness premises are proved redundant from sgraph irreflexivity (sg_edgeNeq), never added; no size, nonempty or uniqueness premise beyond each original is added, so D2str's sizes 0 and 2 stay raw-only. GTMisc.U13.induced_cycle shares the normalized name but is a different contract (an injective map 'I_k -> G whose edges are exactly the modular successor pairs, with its own k = 0, 1, 2 behaviour): deferred-excluded, unchanged, not redirected. Distinct and untouched: U13.has_induced_cycle, the induced-isomorphism copies of cycle_graph n (X49, X60, X29), X115's vertex-set odd induced cycles, X161's bare four-vertex ucycle, X169's clique-tree chordality and the directed chordal_C3; Packing.XE1.xe1_chordal is an unchanged chain here.
summary: Family B23 (sequence induced cycles and holes). Five local helpers now unfold to the three public views of `GTBase.induced_cycles` (not re-exported by base), which share one chord condition `cyclic_chordless c` (every host edge between two vertices of the list joins cyclically consecutive entries, `seq_cyclic_consecutiveb`, no distinctness premise) and differ only in the length bound: `Extremal.conjectures.D2str.induced_cycle` to the raw `chordless_ucycle` by conversion (no length guard: the empty list and the two-vertex cycle of an edge stay raw induced cycles; its `cyc_edge` is the Boolean `seq_cyclic_consecutiveb`); `GTMisc.conjectures.X91.x91_induced_cycle` and `Packing.conjectures.XE1.xe1_induced_cycle` to the genuine `chordless_cycle` (2 < size c, the same term as X91's 3 <= size c) and `Chromatic.conjectures.X3.x3_hole` and `Minor.conjectures.X27.x27_hole` to the `hole` view (3 < size c), each by an explicit iff: the redundant distinctness premises (after the edge in X91 and X27, before it in X3 and XE1) are proved redundant from sgraph irreflexivity (`sg_edgeNeq`), X3's and X91's Prop consecutiveness goes through `seq_cyclic_consecutiveP`, and X3's three-way conjunction is reshaped. The bridges are the public `cyclic_chordless_edge_neq`, `cyclic_chordless_neq_edge`, `cyclic_chordless_prop_edge_neq` and `cyclic_chordless_prop_neq_edge`. No size, nonempty or duplicate-free premise beyond each original is added. `GTMisc.conjectures.U13.induced_cycle` shares the normalized name but is an injective ordinal map whose edges are exactly the modular successor pairs (its own k = 0, 1, 2 behaviour): deferred-excluded, unchanged, not redirected.

Thirteen complete current rows, frozen over the frozen helpers and the ten frozen chains with every guard, quantifier order and status unchanged: Chromatic X3 `bounded_clique_consecutive_hole_lengths_statement` (0 < nu, 3 <= k, omega < k, n <= chi, nu consecutive hole lengths), `bounded_gaps_sets_are_constricting_statement` (positive, infinite, bounded-gap sets are k-constricting for every k), `rainbow_consecutive_vertices_in_hole_statement` (every proper colouring over an arbitrary palette has a hole with s consecutive rainbow vertices after rotation), `clique_or_consecutive_holes_statement`, Chromatic X160 `density_zero_constricting_set_statement` (Boolean integer set, density zero), Extremal D2str `geodesic_cycles_and_tuttes_theorem_statement` (every real field, 3-connectivity, an existential positive symmetric edge length, every geodesic ucycle peripheral), GTMisc X91 `avoidable_path_or_pk_free_statement` (0 < k, induced-path freeness or an avoidable path whose every induced two-ended extension lies in an induced cycle), Minor X27 `bounded_degree_even_hole_free_bounded_treewidth_statement` (solved), X42 `even_hole_k4_diamond_free_bounded_treewidth_statement` (partial), X220 `theta_prism_even_wheel_free_bounded_treewidth_statement` (wheel spokes at least three, odd), `even_hole_kt_free_logarithmic_treewidth_statement` (solved) and `even_hole_diamond_free_bounded_tree_alpha_statement` (partial), and Packing XE1 `erdos_81_statement` (uniform C before G and n; chordal through the unchanged chain `xe1_chordal`; the M1 clique edge partition stays live). No statement text, doc block, manifest row, leg state or status changes; each frozen chain and row keeps the other families' live vocabulary.

History: twelve complete earlier rows are reused, not re-composed: B4's X3Legacy rows (bounded clique, bounded gaps, clique or consecutive holes), B4's X3Original rainbow row (C5's frozen colouring with B4's frozen hole chain), B4's X160Legacy and D2strLegacy rows, B4's X91Original (B3's frozen paths with B4's frozen cycle), C13's X27Original and X42Original (B4's frozen holes, C13's frozen bags, A1's frozen induced-freeness), C19's X220Original (B4's frozen even-wheel chain with C19's frozen model support) and B4's X220Legacy logarithmic and tree-alpha rows; each keeps the raw pair formula and is certified here end to end through its owner's certificate. Because the live holes and induced cycles are no longer convertible to B4's frozen copies (except D2str), the B4 certificates of Chromatic, GTMisc and Minor that reach them, and C19's X220Original certificate, are re-proved through the public bridges: proof-only changes, every theorem statement and frozen body unchanged. All 44 earlier frozen mappings stay byte-exact; the earlier snapshots that keep this family's live names are listed in known_stale_snapshots with reciprocal notes in their specs (B22's partial X91 path chain and row deliberately keep the live x91_induced_cycle).

Consumers: Extremal grounding_D2str (induced_cycle_nil, induced_cycle_ucycle, peripheral_cycle_C0_nil, peripheral_cycle_induced: unchanged proofs, the raw size-0 witness is preserved), Minor foundations/hole_containments (four_cycle_hole, isubgraph_hole and fch_hole: proof-only adaptations through cyclic_chordless_edge_neq; every theorem type, the subdivision / path lemmas and the C18 / C19 / B22 witness APIs unchanged), Minor grounding_X220, implications_X220 and implications_X42 (recompiled unchanged). Routing: normal milestones Chromatic X3 and X160, Extremal D2, GTMisc X91, Minor X27, X42 and X220, Packing XE1; no Digraph source.

Public-only client base/theories/examples/induced_cycles.v: the empty list and K_2's edge are raw chordless ucycles rejected by the genuine view; K_3's triangle is a genuine chordless cycle but not a hole; the four-cycle of cycle_graph 4 is a hole, kept by rotation and reversal; K_4's four-cycle is a size-four ucycle with a chord, rejected by every view; positive facts are shown through the API and by computation with the Boolean mirrors.

Kernel evidence, independent of this textual report, from `Print All Dependencies` and exact `Check`s: no frozen object reaches a live helper of the family or a canonical view; the live rows reach their live helpers and the canonical views; the consumer theorems keep their exact types.
